title: The Architecture of Stillness
subtitle: A Philosophical Meditation
author: Walusimbi Leon (SGSS)
description: A philosophical meditation for the modern reader — on inner peace, time, control, and the art of living deliberately. Inspired by Stoic and contemplative traditions.
style: Calm, luminous, aphoristic prose. Short chapters, each a meditation. Gentle and profound.
characters: The reader as a student of stillness.
notes: Continue the numbered chapters. Each is a self-contained meditation that builds the book's architecture of inner peace.
